subject: Avoid refreshing daylight-saving info on every event-loop wakeup (#4086)
reason: Pure performance change with no externally observable behaviour: the diff only changes how often server.daylight_active is refreshed via localtime_r (every event-loop wakeup before, once per second in serverCron plus whileBlockedCron after). That flag is used solely to render DST in log timestamps; the cached time itself (unixtime/mstime/ustime, LRU/LFU clock) is still updated on every wakeup via updateCachedTime(0), so command replies, expiry, replication, persistence and failover are untouched.
